title.en: Which electric pump prints the high-rise phrase?
title.zh: 哪一台电动泵印了“高层”？

description.en: Electric 60 prints high-rise electric pumping: 90 kW, 40 m³/h, fine stone 200 m / 600 m, 13 mm 150 m / 450 m, 24 mm 100 m / 300 m. Match stone before using 600 m.
description.zh: 电动60印了高层电动泵送：90 kW、40 m³/h，细石 200 m / 600 m，13 mm 150 m / 450 m，24 mm 100 m / 300 m。用 600 m 之前先对石子。

h1.en: Which electric pump prints the high-rise phrase?
h1.zh: 哪一台电动泵印了“高层”？

directAnswer.en: Electric 60. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai lists it for high-rise electric pumping and long-distance fine-stone conveying: 90 kW, 40 m³/h, 35 MPa, hopper 0.7 m³. Fine stone is 200 m horizontal / 600 m vertical. 13 mm stone is 150 m / 450 m. 24 mm stone is 100 m / 300 m. The unit is 6600 × 1800 × 1800 mm and 3300 kg. The 600 m cell is not a floor count.
directAnswer.zh: 电动60。邢台河北品锦机械把它列为高层电动泵送和长距离细石输送：90 kW、40 m³/h、35 MPa、料斗 0.7 m³。细石是水平 200 m / 垂直 600 m。13 mm 石子是 150 m / 450 m。24 mm 石子是 100 m / 300 m。外形 6600 × 1800 × 1800 mm，重量 3300 kg。600 m 这一格不是楼层数。

heading.en: Read 600 m only on the fine-stone row

body.en: The page also says the model is for jobs listed at 40 m³/h. That output is one cell. Distance still splits by stone. A 24 mm building mix is compared with 100 m / 300 m, not with 600 m. Electric 80 is a different high-capacity row: 110 kW, 60 m³/h, 900 m / 300 m and aggregate limited to 2 cm. Do not treat the two “high” phrases as one machine.
body.zh: 该页还写了目录 40 m³/h 的工况。输送量是一个格子。距离仍然按石子分开。24 mm 的建筑料对照 100 m / 300 m，不对照 600 m。电动80是另一行大排量：110 kW、60 m³/h、900 m / 300 m，骨料限在 2 cm。两句“高”不是同一台机器。

heading.en: What this page will not calculate

body.en: It will not turn a storey count into metres, and it will not promise that 40 m³/h appears at the pour. Send the stone label and the measured riser and ground pipe to Xingtai. If the site has no supply for 90 kW, the high-output diesel comparison is Diesel 120 or LZ-80, which are infrastructure and off-grid rows, not a renamed Electric 60.
body.zh: 本页不把层数换成米，也不承诺浇筑点上会出现 40 m³/h。把石子标注、量到的立管和地面管发给邢台。现场供不上 90 kW 时，大排量柴油对照是柴油120或 LZ-80，那是基建和无电网行，不是改名的电动60。

heading.en: What should Xingtai receive with the inquiry?
heading.zh: 向邢台询盘要带上什么？

body.en: Say fine stone, 13 mm or 24 mm, and the measured vertical and horizontal metres. Send Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai the mix, the largest stone or particle, the output you need, the horizontal and vertical pipe you measured, and whether the site has grid voltage or must use diesel. Use /contact, the on-site WhatsApp button, PinjinHebei@Outlook.com or 19912003025. Do not attach a project name, a country job or a daily volume the catalogue does not print.
body.zh: 请说明是细石、13 mm 还是 24 mm，并给出量到的垂直与水平米数。 请把配合比、最大石子或粒径、需要的输送量、量到的水平与垂直管路，以及现场是电网还是必须用柴油，发给邢台的河北品锦机械。途径是 /contact、站内 WhatsApp、PinjinHebei@Outlook.com 或 19912003025。不要附上目录里没有的项目名称、国家工程或日浇筑方量。

answer.en: No. Fine stone is 200 m horizontal / 600 m vertical.
answer.zh: 不是。细石是水平 200 m / 垂直 600 m。

answer.en: No. Electric 15 prints 15–20 m vertical and 60–80 m horizontal for rural and small-site work.
answer.zh: 不能。电动15给农村和小型工地印的是垂直 15–20 m、水平 60–80 m。

question.en: Is a boom pump listed for high-rise?

answer.en: No. Pinjin lists trailer line pumps. Electric 60 is one of them.
answer.zh: 没有。品锦列出的是拖式管道泵。电动60是其中一台。

alt.zh: 河北品锦机械电动60型混凝土泵，目录列为高层电动泵送
